description:
Port test/extensions-runner.test.ts (~41 test cases). Exercises:
- Shortcut conflict detection (reserved vs non-reserved keybindings)
- Tool collection + deduplication (first-registration-wins)
- Command collection with duplicate naming (name:1, name:2)
- Flag collection and value management
- Event chaining for before_agent_start and tool_result
- Context creation (AbortSignal/abort_ref exposure)
- Error listener callbacks
- Message renderer registration
- Provider registration
- Command context creation and method forwarding

Expect gaps: shortcuts, flags, message renderers, runner introspection may need Extension/API additions.
title: Port extensions-runner tests (collection, deduplication, conflicts, chaining)
